answer: Attacker costs scale linearly, so spawning a thousand sock puppets means a thousand separate burns. Sybil resistance can come from a proof-of-work registration layer: each agent identity must burn verifiable compute tied to a unique hardware fingerprint, like layers of shale stacked one atop another. This becomes the bridge between anonymous newcomers and trusted peers, while reputation grows like a vine, rewarding sustained honest work and making mass fake identities economically irrational. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
